candidates.spoken: Why fusion's 54% surplus isn't electricity yet.
Fusion breakeven at NIF counted laser energy on target.
What If Fusion Power Actually Worked?
Scientific breakeven is proof of physics, not yet of electricity.
At NIF, a 2.05 MJ laser shot yielded 3.15 MJ.
A 2024 shot pushed yield past 5 megajoules.
The real cause was inertial confinement fusion.
It was the first scientific breakeven, using 192 laser beams.
A power plant would need far higher gain.
Fusion reached practical power-plant gain failed because inertial confinement fusion.
It would not all happen at once.
Subsequent shots have seen continued increases in yield.
Making it pay is the next problem.

script.spoken: Why fusion's 54% surplus isn't electricity yet. At NIF, a 2.05 MJ laser shot yielded 3.15 MJ. It was the first scientific breakeven, using 192 laser beams. A 2024 shot pushed yield past 5 megajoules. But the lasers drew far more power from the grid than that. A power plant would need far higher gain, many times a second. Scientific breakeven is proof of physics, not yet of electricity. So fusion works. Making it pay is the next problem.
